# The shared local rename helper rejects missing folders before dereferencing them

LocalRenameOrReparentFolder checks sourceFolder and newParentFolder before reading the source name. Current server updates separately reject failed ID lookups, while rename and move callbacks propagate local helper errors. The boundary guard and lookup correction are separate defenses. Valid-folder sync tests check names, membership and stable IDs; they do not exercise null arguments or prove the reported crash was cured.

Scope: Offline folder rename argument contract.
